records.name: Saibabeam
records.effect: Green energy wave fired from the Saibaman's head gland.

notes: The current sources explicitly identify Saibabeam as a Super Skill and an Energy Wave, with Xenoverse 2 cast-only users. It is mapped to the repository's Ki Blast Super taxonomy. Exact Ki cost and acquisition are intentionally null. Poison is not added because current evidence says the Poison skill does not return in Xenoverse 2, while Acid's exact repository subtype remains unresolved.
